products.product_description: Frozen Hot Smoked Vacuum Packed Salmon
products.code_info: Batch number 71013 (this represents the production date) Best by date is 12/10/13
products.reason_for_recall: Frozen Hot Smoked Vacuum-Packed Salmon packaged in 1.5 lb packages is being recalled due to missing information on the label. Specifically, "Important: Keep Frozen Until Used. Thaw under Refrigerated immediately before use". Failure to provide instructions on the label for proper storage and handling of the product can cause Clostridium botulinum to grow and produce toxin.
